title.narrative: A.O.11. Number of organisations with policies and procedures to ensure an environment which is gender sensitive

comment.narrative: The involvement of women, minorities and other disadvantaged groups is hardly represented in the horticulture education and the sector as a whole

25-02-2021: A gender working group, MUST together with the 5 colleges has been formed. This group will develop a framework for the gender policy and awareness at each of the institutes. The framework will be adapted based on the needs of each college.

title.narrative: A.E.1. Number of (knowledge) institutions supported directly

comment.narrative: The current horticulture education system in Kenya is fractured and does neither allow a smooth educational career upwards nor easy access to the labour market. The TVCs are currently not offering specialized courses in horticulture and as such do not serve the horticulture sector .
25-02-2021: MUST has signed MoUs with each of the 5 participating colleges
Five (5) agriculture education institutions supported directly to offer Competence based education.
